name: African Head Charge
hook: On-U Sound's debut act, built around a Ghanaian percussionist and Adrian Sherwood's mixing desk rather than a fixed lineup.
blurb: African Head Charge was formed around percussionist Bonjo Iyabinghi Noah and producer Adrian Sherwood, and released On-U Sound's first album, 'My Life in a Hole in the Ground', in 1981, layering African and Caribbean percussion under heavy dub production. It is less a fixed band than a name for whoever Sherwood brought together around Noah's percussion at a given session, which makes it an early, clear example of how On-U Sound worked: dub techniques applied to a changing cast rather than a stable line-up.

signatureTracks.title: My Life in a Hole in the Ground
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: On-U Sound's debut release, and the founding statement of the label's dub-plus-percussion approach.

signatureTracks.title: Off the Beaten Track
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: A later, denser record showing the project's dub production growing more layered across the decade.
